text.description_html:
JNF -EP312-154-630, Oval Stainless Steel Edge Pull with Hidden Handle

The Modern 6 Inch Oblong Edge Pull features a hinged grip that is flush with the surface of the pocket door pull until the upper portion is pushed in (click on picture to the right to see it open). This modern edge pull comes in a satin stainless steel finish. It is pressured mounted into the door for a clean installation without the use of screws. Made by JNF in Portugal, this pocket door handle is great for heavy doors where a small fingertip grip just is not practical.

Specifications for the Modern Oval Edge Pull with Finger Cover:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Length: 6"
  • Width: 1-5/32"
  • Projection: 1/16"
  • Door Cutout Depth: 9/16"
  • Door Cutout Length: 5-27/32"
  • Door Cutout Width: 15/16"
  • Finger Cutout Length: 5-5/8"
  • Finger Cutout Width: 3/4"
